prompt: STUDENTS_ROLL Master student roll / enrollment Each row is one student in one school–class–section–year. Typical fields: school, student name, father name, SMS number, roll number, class, section, year, group (Science/Arts/etc.), category (CATEGROY: B, DS, S, and related codes), and related IDs (board roll where used). Use for: Who is enrolled, strength counts, class lists, finding a student by name, SMS number, or roll number.

MARKS Subject-wise theory (or combined) exam marks Student-grain marks joined to the roll on roll number + class + year. Fields include exam type (Annual, Midterm, Mock, and similar), subject, obtained, total, percentage (%), and often grade or status. Use for: A student’s marks, fail lists, top scorers, class averages, and percentage bands (90–100, 80–90, …, 0–39).

PRAC Practical papers only Same grain as MARKS, but practical papers only (Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, and similar science practicals). Fields follow obtained, total, and percentage. Use for: Practical obtained/total/%, practical pass/fail, and theory versus practical comparison.

TR2_THEORY Teacher-wise theory result summary Built from theory marks plus teacher assignment. Grain: teacher (EID, name) × school × exam × subject × class × section × year × category. Measures: strength, appeared, passed, pass%, class average, and band counts (Count_90_100 … Count_0_39). Use for: How a teacher’s theory class performed: pass%, averages, and grade bands.

TR2_PRAC Teacher-wise practical result summary Page 3 EduQuery AI — Schema Guide and Gold Prompt Catalog Same structure as TR2_THEORY, for practical results. Use for: Practical class average, practical pass%, and practical grade bands by teacher.

TR_ALL Combined teacher result sheet Combined teacher result (theory + practical / all subjects), used as the main annual/board teacher detail. Same KPI set as the TR2 views, plus exam type. Coordinators use it for annual detail, including top-student context. Use for: Teacher class performance by exam, pass%, averages, and bands.

ALL_COMBINED Teacher career / ranking snapshot Not limited to a single exam. Adds position, total positions, above 70, below 70, and workload (WL). Categories include BOARD, MIDDLE, BOARD_CAREER, MIDDLE_CAREER, and ALL SEC CAT. Use for: Rank teachers, compare schools, review workload versus pass%, and compare career versus one-year views.

HOF_FRMT Head Office formatted teacher performance Head Office formatted teacher performance sheet (the formatted sister of HOF, used in Head Office interview and HO reports). Teacher identity plus result KPIs: pass%, class average, bands, position, workload, and often comparison with board percentage. Use for: HO interview packs, official teacher result format, and board versus school pass%.

INTERNAL_EXAM_GROUP_WISE_PERFORMANCE_VIEW Internal exam group-wise teacher performance Internal-exam (non-Annual) teacher performance by group. Fields: school, exam type, EID, teacher name, year, class, section, subject, group, appeared, absent, pass, grade counts A+ through F, class%, class average, below 70%, and above 70%. Use for: Midterm/Mock/Monthly teacher results, absents, grade mix, and group-wise internal performance.

SCHOOL_IND_POS_SUB School individual position by subject Student rank in a subject inside a school/class (and usually section/year). Use for: 1st/2nd/3rd in a subject, subject-wise merit lists, and who is top in a subject at a given school and class.

STUDENT_RESULT_TOTAL Board / annual student result cards One row per student per subject (plus a SUBJECT = TOTAL overall row). Fields: school, student, father, class, section, category, year, SMSNO, roll number, group, subject, obtained, total, %, and status. Application code Page 4 EduQuery AI — Schema Guide and Gold Prompt Catalog also refers to this grain as STUDENTS_RESULT_TOTAL — same idea: board/annual result card. Use for: Annual/board report cards, overall %, fail subjects, and school-wise subject averages.

STUDENT_RESULT_TOTAL_INTERNAL Internal exam student result cards Same idea as STUDENT_RESULT_TOTAL for internal exams (Midterm, Mock, Monthly, class tests): subject marks, percentage, grade, status, and often house and exam name. Use for: Internal report cards, exam-to-exam comparison, and internal fail lists.

vTeacher_sum_per Teacher overall percentage (board vs middle) Teacher overall percentage summary (obtained versus total). The live dashboard uses a close view, vTeacher_sum_per_BOARD_MIDDLE, split into Board versus Middle percentages. Use for: A teacher’s overall board %, middle %, or combined career %. How they connect
